data.long_description:
Experience elevated waterfront living in Unit 3102A at Urban Oasis by Missoni, located in the heart of Business Bay. This stunning 2-bedroom apartment offers 1,233.5 SQFT of beautifully designed living space, fully furnished with elegant interiors inspired by Missoni’s signature style.

Situated on a high floor, the unit features spacious bedrooms, modern bathrooms, a bright open-plan living and dining area, and floor-to-ceiling windows that enhance natural light and showcase breathtaking city and canal views. The fully fitted kitchen comes equipped with quality appliances, making it perfect for both end-users and investors.

Property Highlights:
- 2 Bedrooms
- Fully Furnished
- 1,233.5 SQFT
- High-Floor Unit
- Modern Open Layout
- Premium Waterfront Location

Urban Oasis offers world-class amenities including a swimming pool, state-of-the-art gym, landscaped areas, and direct access to the Dubai Canal promenade combining luxury, comfort, and convenience in one prestigious address.

Perfect for homeowners seeking upscale city living or investors looking for strong rental potential in Business Bay.
data.title: 2 bedroom apartment to rent
